metadata.title: Trusted Data

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asserting institutional trust in data through consistent ownership, protection, governance, and lifecycle management.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Enterprise data assets, data services, records, cryptographic trust mechanisms, and data governance platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Secure Data architecture composed of data trust foundations, classification semantics, handling constraints, cryptographic protection, loss prevention, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Institutional datasets, records, transactional data, content artifacts, metadata, cryptographic material, and audit traces.

props.name: dependency-class
props.remarks: Trusted Data is a Tier-1 institutional dependency underpinning all digital services, decision‑making, and compliance obligations.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Trusted Data inherits baseline data trust invariants from Data Core.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Trusted Data relies on Secure Identity for attribution, accountability, and access enforcement.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Trusted Data relies on Secure Network for protected transport, segmentation, and monitoring.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misuse of valid access to improperly access, modify, or exfiltrate institutional data.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or secondary use of sensitive data beyond authorized purpose or scope.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration of institutional data through trusted or permitted channels.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance ensures data is retained, protected, and disposed of according to obligation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access and flow enforcement prevent unauthorized data use and movement.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Auditability and observability support accountability and investigation.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.value: PL, AC, IA, AU, SC, SI, MP
props.remarks: Trusted Data aligns with NIST SP 800-53 security and privacy control families covering data protection, access, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Institutional data frequently crosses system and organizational boundaries and requires explicit trust and responsibility definition.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Trusted Data aligns with Privacy Framework principles for purpose limitation, minimization, and lifecycle discipline.

metadata.remarks: Trusted Data is the composite governance pattern asserting institutional trust in data assets. The ATT&CK and D3FEND references in this pattern serve as systemic rationale for treating data as a first‑class security domain. Detailed enforcement is defined in Data Core and associated Secure Data constraint patterns.
